name: mir2-mobile
description: Capacitor mobile shell (Android / iOS) for mir2-web3

scripts.android: npm run build && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build && cap open ios
scripts.android:build: npm run build && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ios:build: npm run build && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -workspace App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
